name: XLA_SEG_RULES_B
description: This table contains for all account rules.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the account rule is seeded.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of a rule that derives account combination values for a journal entry line.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a rule that derives account combination values for a journal entry line.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_COA_ID
columns.description: Transaction chart of account identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_COA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the chart of accounts that is associated to the ledger that owns the journal entry.

columns.name: FLEXFIELD_ASSIGN_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Type of account rule definition. Possible values include Account Combination, Segment, or Value Set.

columns.name: FLEXFIELD_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of an accounting flexfield segment.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the segment rule is enabled.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a group of values and related attributes assigned to a key flexfield segment (account) or to a descriptive flexfield segment. Values in each value set have the same maximum length, validation type, and alphanumeric option.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate if the account derivation rule is updated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
